status: Concept storyboard only. No video submitted, generated or connected.
tool: Built-in Imagegen; no Higgsfield credits spent.
camera: Forward along a fixed central optical axis with a gentle rise to clear the shore ledge. No lateral truck, orbit, pan, yaw or roll. Nearby objects grow radially outward; distant mountains move minimally.

frames.beat: Advance directly over the shallows. The stationary raffia hat grows and is cropped naturally beyond the right edge; it never flies or changes shape.
Reach a low granite shore ledge and dry uphill conifer corridor straight ahead. Water remains in the summer foreground only; no second lake behind the ledge.

Pass very close to soft hanging green pine sprays while gently clearing the ledge. Real defocused foliage occludes the distant scenery and conceals the location/light edit. No sideways trunk curtain, fog or white flash.
Emerge on the cool spring overlook beneath the same cherry branch, with the stationary grey-blue floral hat smaller than its final size. Continue forward into the exact approved spring anchor.

constraints: Video is explicitly deferred until a later request
No changes to existing videos or pilot player
Lake and sand only in summer
No lake or water in spring
No hat morphs, duplicate hats or hats on the ground
No global sideways sweep, orange HDR treatment, repeating textures or procedural bark
realism: Photographic colour, plausible sun/reflected fill, matte irregular stone and bark, real focus falloff. The soft foliage is an intentional close optical obstruction, not a fog or blur filter.
limits: The endpoints are independently generated locations, not a verified shared 3D landscape. A short concealed edit is required. These planning images do not prove continuous video motion; timing and frame seams remain to be checked on a future render. Avoid depicting a kilometre-wide lake crossing in a few seconds.
